acceptanceCriteria: TestExperimentalKernelAdapterContext passes on a host whose load average exceeds 100, or the fresh-snapshot case no longer races the production 250 ms deadline.
The test still proves a missing snapshot abstains with index-snapshot-unavailable and a fresh snapshot yields the framed kernel block.
body: Seen 2026-09-27 in a focused cmd/corvint run on c-rc2c (base 3d44b978, host load average about 180 from other processes): cmd/corvint/host_adapter_test.go:597 failed with `session-start: injected block differs from the framed kernel verb output: "\nCorvint experimental compaction kernel NOT_RUN: index-snapshot-unavailable\n"`. The test is serial by design so the fresh-snapshot case loads within experimentalKernelDeadline (cmd/corvint/host_adapter_experimental.go:22, 250 ms, applied at :47), but load from other processes still exceeds it. It passed when rerun alone. The kernel path is experimental and off by default (decision 0099), so this is a test flake, not a product defect; it can fail make gate on a loaded host, as V1-0356 did for the Gemini hook.
title: TestExperimentalKernelAdapterContext fails under host load: 250 ms kernel deadline
